name: Kettlebell Single-Arm Clean and Jerk
steps: Stand behind the bell and hinge at the hips to grasp the handle with one hand.
Hike the bell between your legs, drive your hips forward and slide your hand through the handle to receive it at your shoulder.
Dip your knees, then drive upward with your legs to send the bell overhead.
Bend your knees again to catch the bell on a straight arm, then stand tall.
Lower the bell to your shoulder and guide it back to the floor before switching arms.
tips: Let your legs and hips power both the clean and the jerk so your arm stays fresh and crisp.
Pause briefly in stable overhead lockout before guiding the kettlebell back down.
